research_scope: Source-free independent Wave2 review: these aliases identify shared prerequisite mathematical constructions only; additional axioms or multiplicity remain attached to parent source texts. Gate/source/certification unchanged.

aliases.reason: In the preordered-set source, transitivity of relation ≤ on I is ∀i,j,k (i≤j and j≤k ⇒ i≤k). In the equivalence-relation source, transitivity of ∼ on S is the identical quantified binary-relation property, with only variables and notation renamed. Reflexivity, symmetry and all preorder/equivalence requirements stay parent-specific and are not implied by transitivity alone.

The presheaf-fibre-product source requires two natural transformations F⇒G and H⇒G between contravariant set-valued presheaves, with component maps compatible with restriction. The representable-presheaf-morphism source requires exactly the same natural-transformation prerequisite for one map. Two-arrow multiplicity, common target G, fibre product and representability conditions remain parent-specific.

The unital-ring-homomorphism source stipulates R and S are each associative rings with a specified multiplicative identity. Each individually has the exact unital ring structure also used in the unital Boolean-ring source. The existence of two rings and the additional equation φ(1_R)=1_S are constraints of the homomorphism source; they are not part of the definition of one unital ring.

The compatible-localized-sections source requires finite elements f_i to generate the entire unital ring R, equivalently (f_1,...,f_n)=R and a linear combination Σ r_i f_i=1. The relatively-prime-polynomial source uses the identical unit ideal (1)=R, specialized to R=k[x]. Their shared prerequisite is the unit ideal; the finite-generation equality and number of generators remain parent-specific conditions.
